answers.core: It would be helpful to not require people to have to seek out an extension to do something that seems like it should exist and also I just have no idea if it's possible to be in an extension.
answers.workaround: A way this could be worked around would be using GPU colliders but that's another node cluttering the hierarchy when there's already a node that handles collisions. It might be my lack on investigation in GPU colliders but I also don't know if there's an easy way to use a custom collision shape for them which would add the limitation of having to box it out in other shapes.

title: Add support for creating GPUParticles3D collision shapes in the Advanced Import Settings dialog
